projects.name: jèrè
projects.description: Business management software for small businesses in Nigeria. Record sales, expenses, stock and the money customers owe you, and see your estimated profit. Live in early access, by access code.
highlights: Sales, stock, expenses and customer debts in one place
Estimated profit by day, week, month, quarter and year
Cashiers record sales and never see costs or profit
Download your records or delete your account yourself

Jèrè sales list with WhatsApp receipts (practice business, made-up figures)
Jèrè stock list with low-stock flags (practice business, made-up figures)
Jèrè team access, choosing what a cashier can see (practice business, made-up figures)

projects.problem: Sales come in as cash, transfers and POS payments. Money goes out for transport, electricity, rent and stock, and customers take goods on credit. By night it is spread across a notebook, WhatsApp and memory, so many owners cannot say what they actually made.
projects.solution: Jèrè takes the cost of the goods you sold and your expenses away from your sales, so you see estimated profit and not just money collected. Sales, stock, expenses and debts sit in one place, and you decide what each team member can see.
keyFeatures: Record sales paid by cash, transfer, POS or on credit, including part-payments
Stock list with restocking and low-stock flags
Customers who owe you, with payments and WhatsApp reminders you send yourself
Estimated profit for a day, week, month, quarter or year, compared with the period before
Which products make you the most money, and which sell below cost
Business capital kept apart from sales and profit
Money you owe suppliers, tracked separately from profit
Team access: invite a cashier by code and choose what they can see
Download your records or delete your account yourself
Add it to your phone's home screen
roadmap: Early-access pilot with a small group of Nigerian businesses (in progress)
Legal review of the privacy page and terms
Pricing announced before the free period ends

projects.name: FXCopilot
projects.description: An FX co-pilot platform focused on decision support, clarity, and workflow automation for traders and teams.
projects.problem: FX traders rely on scattered tools for analysis, notes, and execution, slowing down decisions.
projects.solution: FXCopilot centralizes trading workflows and decision support into a clean, focused interface.

projects.name: RebirthAgro
projects.description: A digital agriculture platform connecting farmers, buyers, and logistics for better access and transparency.
projects.problem: Farmers often lack direct access to buyers and transparent pricing.
projects.solution: RebirthAgro bridges farmers, buyers, and logistics through a mobile-first digital platform.
